quality.metaDescription: TankQ's quality standards, materials and testing process.
quality.title: Production Standards & QC Process
quality.subtitle: Every tank inspected before delivery - Hydrostatic Test | Barcol Hardness | Visual QC | QC Certificate
quality.processImageAlt: TankQ FRP tank production process diagram
quality.processStep1Description: Engineer reviews chemical, temperature, pressure. Selects appropriate resin and laminate schedule.
quality.processStep2Description: Clean mold, apply first Gel Coat layer evenly, color per customer spec.
quality.processStep3Description: Apply Chopped Strand Mat and Woven Roving alternating layers per laminate schedule.
quality.processStep4Description: Measure thickness at all positions. Barcol Hardness ≥40 to confirm complete cure.
quality.processStep5Description: Fill with water and test at 1.25× design pressure for minimum 1 hour with zero leaks.
quality.processStep6Description: Visual inspection inside and out, polish top coat, clean, apply marking before packing.
quality.processStep7Description: Prepare QC Certificate with all test results, As-built Drawing, and Material Certificate.
quality.processStep8Description: Pack with shock protection, ship by special transport with installation and commissioning team (optional).
quality.qcRow8Standard: COC for resin and fiber attached
